nodes.name: Tooltip / Switch to Claude Code workspace
Notes
nodes.text: Website favorites open sites. The bottom dock switches workspaces. The personal workspace stays selected while an agent works elsewhere.

nodes.name: Behavior notes
nodes.text:
Favorites = websites
Pinned = persistent workspace tabs
Tabs = current browsing session
Workspace dock = switch tab collections

Prototype: hover favorite and workspace icons for labels. Click Pinned to collapse or expand.

The tab list scrolls independently.
The workspace dock stays visible.

nodes.name: Compact example note
nodes.text: The 1100 × 720 example shows an agent working in its own workspace while Personal remains selected. Activity and Pause are illustrative, not a live agent connection.
